Why this app reads health data

Coś ty żarła Sync reads your steps, active calories, workouts and sleep from Health Connect and sends daily totals to your private Coś ty żarła account. The app uses them to adjust your daily calorie target and pre-fill your sleep. Nothing is shared with anyone else, and you can disconnect at any time.
